overview:
The City of Lakes and the Great Wall of India from Gurugram: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip leaves Gurugram in the evening in an AC deluxe vehicle and travels overnight to Udaipur.

Day 1 covers Saheliyon ki Bari, Fateh Sagar Lake and its market for Udaipur's local food. Day 2 is the city day: Lake Pichola, the City Palace, Jagdish Temple and Gangaur Ghat, then the folk performance at Bagore ki Haveli (7-8 PM) or the local flea market. Day 3 is Kumbhalgarh Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site whose 38 km wall is the second longest after the Great Wall of China, before the overnight drive back to Gurugram. Prices start at ₹7,499 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
